name: print-social-blue-glow-agency-post-quartet
title: Four dark posts with glowing blue starburst and thin sans
whatItIs: A 2x2 set of black squares with glowing blue shapes: a blurred star, rising chart with a glowing line, stacked translucent panels, and a ring of tiny text with a radiant glow. Small light sans headlines and pill buttons sit in each.
whatItMeans: Sleek and futuristic; glow and blur feel like a premium tech brand.
techniques: Use blurred glowing shapes as the only imagery.
Set small light headlines with pill CTAs.
Vary the shape in each post while keeping the same colour.
Use circular text as a graphic.

vocabulary.definition: A blurred luminous form used as artwork.
A group of posts with a black base.
